        source_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        CHECK((kind='legacy' AND source_epoch IS NULL AND source_revision IS NULL

        policy_json TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('planned','running','completed','blocked')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE sync_checkpoint (checkpoint_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        publication_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sync_publication(publication_id),
        receiver_version_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        format_version INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE sync_checkpoint_retirement (origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin_kind IN ('publication','recovery')),

        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

        retired_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(origin_kind,checkpoint_id))

CREATE TABLE sync_pair (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot=1),
        source_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        protocol_version INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        paired_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE sync_publication (publication_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        source_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, knowledge_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        committed_at TEXT NOT NULL, local_version_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE sync_publication_fence (publication_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sync_publication(publication_id),
        generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0))

CREATE TABLE sync_published_video (publication_id TEXT NOT NULL, video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        media_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, committed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(publication_id,video_id))

CREATE TABLE sync_queue (
  item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'queued',
  attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  lease_until TEXT,
  last_error_class TEXT,
  created_at TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT,
  owner_id TEXT,
  owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lease_token TEXT,
  lease_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  retry_at TEXT,
  video_id TEXT,
  publication_id TEXT,
  result_hash TEXT,

CREATE TABLE sync_queue_budget_receipt (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

        publication_id TEXT NOT NULL, video_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(publication_id,video_id)

CREATE TABLE sync_recovery_checkpoint (checkpoint_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE TABLE sync_recovery_control (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot=1),

CREATE TABLE sync_report (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
